Hi Amir / Sofia — thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed path for the pilot (so we can lock timelines & owners):

Summary of what you asked for
- Replace intake triage for prior-auth forms + surface structured metadata to downstream systems.
- High recall for matching relevant fields; false positives need to be <2% on sampled production traffic.
- Data isolation + SOC2/compliance details prior to any customer data staging.

Draft success criteria (please confirm):
1) Offline labeled dataset: F1 >= 0.88 on the end-to-end extraction task (span + label).
2) Live shadow run: P95 latency < 350ms for 1k token request distribution.
3) Hallucination tolerance: fewer than 1 critical hallucination per 10k tokens on red-team prompts.
4) Operational: KV-cache hit rate >= 60% for repeated patient templates during the 2-week shadow window.

Evaluation approach options (pick one or hybrid):
- Offline-only: run a curated, labeled holdout of ~2k records; grade per the rubric in the attached spreadsheet. Fast, deterministic, lower infra risk.
- Shadow-first (recommended): 1 week shadow in parallel with production (no return-to-user), plus offline regression on the labeled set. This shows real-world distribution and tokenizer/latency behavior.

Proposed timeline / owners
- May 10: sign off success criteria & legal SOP for data staging (owner: Amir + Redwood legal).
- May 17: dataset handoff & baseline offline eval (owner: Solstice data lead + Rachel Kim).
- May 24–30: shadow window (owner: Marissa / CS + Ben for infra).
- Jun 7: pilot review + decision (owner: Jonas).

Attachments: solstice_poc_criteria.xlsx — contains a suggested grading rubric, sample labels, and a column-level mapping to your schema.

Next steps
- Can you confirm whether you prefer Shadow-first or Offline-only?
- Who is the internal compliance/engineering contact that would sign the data-handling SOP?

Happy to schedule a 30-min handshake next week to finalize.

Thanks,
Jonas

Thanks Amir — looping in a bit more detail from our side so everyone has a concrete eval path. Replying inline to keep context: 

> 1) Preference: we lean toward Shadow-first so we can vet behavior on our real traffic, but we want an offline labeled check to validate edge cases (esp. forms with scanned PDFs).

Totally agree — hybrid is the safest: shadow to validate live distribution and latency, offline to sanity-check extraction accuracy on hand-labeled edge cases (OCR/scanned).

Proposed grading rubric (high level):
- Extraction accuracy (span + label): weighted 60% — F1 thresholds: >=0.88 (pass), 0.82–0.87 (accept with remediation), <0.82 (fail).
- False positive rate (business critical fields): weighted 20% — target <2% for pass.
- Latency & reliability: weighted 10% — P95 <350ms & error-rate <0.5%.
- Safety/hallucination checks: weighted 10% — critical hallucinations per 10k tokens <0.1 to pass.

Scoring: Pass if weighted score >= 0.75 and no single critical metric in fail range. We will provide a sample scoring sheet (see attached runbook) and a short script to compute scores.

Operational plan & ownership:
- Dataset handoff: Rachel Kim (onboarding/data) will coordinate labels and schema mapping (Rachel to confirm availability May 12–14).
- Infra & shadow ops: Ben Carter will provision the shadow cluster and monitor token throughput (Ben to run pre-check May 20).
- CS & experiment monitoring: Marissa will run daily check-ins during shadow (May 24–30).
- Legal/SOP sign-off: Jonas will coordinate with Amir and Lisa for SOC2 + data handling.

Attachments: trial_runbook.md (runbook + scoring script stub) and solution_arch_diagram.png (infra reference).

Can we lock the kickoff for Tue May 18 at 10am PT? If that works for your eng/compliance leads we'll send calendar invite.
